chunks: Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who maries off his slave-girl; is it proper for him to allow her to look at his private parts? He said, 'No,' and I am cautious of that with my slave-girl when I marry her off.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a slave-girl to look at her master's private parts after he maries her off?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the etiquette of *awrah* (private parts) visibility between a master and his slave-girl upon marriage, emphasizing that while not strictly forbidden, it is recommended (*mustahabb*) for the master to avoid it as a mark of modesty. The Imam’s personal practice serves as a practical model (*uswa*) for believers, illustrating that social hierarchy does not negate the need for dignified boundaries in intimate domestic relations. This ruling reflects the broader Shia legal principle of balancing ownership rights with moral refinement (*adab*).
